newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Inmates take staff hostage in Austrian prison.
newsitem.headline: Inmates take staff hostage in Austrian prison.

text.p: Inmates took three prison canteen staff hostage at a jail in the southern Austrian town of Graz on Thursday and police were negotiating with them over their demand for a getaway helicopter, television reported.
It said said two guards were believed injured in the incident.
Police confirmed that prison staff had been taken hostage but said they had no further details.
Television said three prisoners serving long sentences demanded a ransom to free the canteen workers and a getaway helicopter, threatening to kill the hostages if their demands were not met.
Police sealed off the jail and opened negotiations with the prisoners, it added.
